source.prompt: A flat, front-on decorative panel, square, 2048x2048, on a solid flat bright magenta background (#ff00ff). Orthographic, flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no cast shadows, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The pattern must repeat: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Ceremonial South Asian Ruby Zenana Dream-Sibyl coin-veil lattice: eight staggered horizontal rows of small round satin-stamped gold coins (#d8a834, ten coins per row) embossed with miniature spoked calendar wheels, linked vertically and diagonally by braided gold wire strung with faceted red carnelian (#a82020) and deep green emerald (#1b7a48) beads; every gap in the chain-and-bead mesh shows only the solid flat bright magenta background (#ff00ff). Hard clean edges against the magenta (#ff00ff), no anti-aliased fringe of other colours. No magenta, pink or purple anywhere in the subject.
